sentences.text: Muammar Mohammed Abu Minyar Gaddafi -LRB- -LSB- ˈmoʊ.əmɑr _ ɡəˈdɑːfi -RSB- ; 20 October 2011 -RRB- , commonly known as Colonel Gaddafi , was a Libyan revolutionary , politician , and political theorist .	Colonel	Colonel	revolutionary	revolutionary	politician	politician	political theorist	Political philosophy

He governed Libya as Revolutionary Chairman of the Libyan Arab Republic from 1969 to 1977 and then as the `` Brotherly Leader '' of the Great Socialist People 's Libyan Arab Jamahiriya from 1977 to 2011 .	Libya	Libya	Libyan Arab Republic	Libyan Arab Republic	Libyan Arab Jamahiriya	Libyan Arab Jamahiriya	Brotherly Leader	Brotherly Leader and Guide of the Revolution	Jamahiriya	Jamahiriya

He was initially ideologically committed to Arab nationalism and Arab socialism , but he came to rule according to his own Third International Theory .	Arab nationalism	Arab nationalism	Arab socialism	Arab socialism	Third International Theory	Third International Theory
Gaddafi was born near Sirte to an impoverished Bedouin family .	Sirte	Sirte	Bedouin	Bedouin
He became an Arab nationalist while at school in Sabha , later enrolling in the Royal Military Academy , Benghazi .	Sabha	Sabha, Libya

Within the military he founded a revolutionary cell which , in a 1969 coup , deposed the Western-backed Senussi monarchy of Idris .	Idris	Idris of Libya	revolutionary	revolutionary	1969 coup	Libyan coup d'etat (1969)	Senussi	Senussi	monarchy	monarchy
Having taken power , Gaddafi converted Libya into a republic governed by his Revolutionary Command Council .	Libya	Libya	Revolutionary Command Council	Libyan Revolutionary Command Council

Ruling by decree , he ejected both Italian colonists and Western military bases from Libya while strengthening ties to Arab nationalist governments -- particularly Gamal Abdel Nasser 's Egypt -- and unsuccessfully advocating Pan-Arab political union .	Libya	Libya	Ruling by decree	Rule by decree	Italian colonists	Italian settlers in Libya	Gamal Abdel Nasser	Gamal Abdel Nasser	Pan-Arab political union	Pan-Arabism

An Islamic modernist , he introduced sharia as the basis for the legal system and promoted `` Islamic socialism '' .	Islamic modernist	Islamic Modernism	sharia	sharia	Islamic socialism	Islamic socialism

The oil industry was nationalised , with the increasing state revenues used to bolster the military , fund foreign revolutionaries , and implement social programs emphasising house-building , healthcare , and education projects .

In 1973 , he initiated a `` Popular Revolution '' with the formation of General People 's Committees , purported to be a system of direct democracy , but retained personal control over major decisions .	direct democracy	direct democracy
He outlined his Third International Theory that year , publishing these ideas in The Green Book .	Third International Theory	Third International Theory	The Green Book	The Green Book (Muammar Gaddafi)
In 1977 , Gaddafi transformed Libya into a new socialist state called the Jamahiriya -LRB- `` state of the masses '' -RRB- .	Libya	Libya	socialist state	socialist state	Jamahiriya	Jamahiriya
Officially he adopted a symbolic role in governance but remained head of both the military and the Revolutionary Committees responsible for policing and suppressing dissent .

During the 1970s and 1980s , Libya 's unsuccessful border conflicts with Egypt and Chad , support for foreign militants , and alleged responsibility for the Lockerbie bombing left it increasingly isolated on the international stage .	Libya	Libya	Lockerbie bombing	Pan Am Flight 103

A particularly hostile relationship developed with the United States , United Kingdom , and Israel , resulting in the 1986 U.S. bombing of Libya and United Nations-imposed economic sanctions .	Libya	Libya	1986 U.S. bombing of Libya	1986 United States bombing of Libya	United Nations	United Nations

From 1999 , Gaddafi rejected Arab socialism and encouraged economic privatisation , rapprochement with Western nations , and Pan-Africanism ; he was Chairperson of the African Union from 2009 -- 10 .	Chairperson of the African Union	Chairperson of the African Union	Arab socialism	Arab socialism	Pan-Africanism	Pan-Africanism	Chairperson	Chairperson of the African Union	African Union	African Union
Amid the 2011 Arab Spring , protests against widespread corruption and unemployment broke out in eastern Libya .	Libya	Libya	Arab Spring	Arab Spring

The situation descended into civil war , in which NATO intervened militarily on the side of the anti-Gaddafist National Transitional Council -LRB- NTC -RRB- .	civil war	Libyan Civil War	NATO	NATO	intervened militarily	2011 military intervention in Libya	National Transitional Council	National Transitional Council
The government was overthrown and Gaddafi , who had retreated to Sirte , was captured and killed by NTC militants .	Sirte	Sirte	captured and killed	Death of Muammar Gaddafi
A highly divisive figure , Gaddafi dominated Libya 's politics for four decades and was the subject of a pervasive cult of personality .	Libya	Libya	cult of personality	cult of personality

He was decorated with various awards and lauded for his anti-imperialist stance , his support for Arab and then African unity , and for significant improvements that his government brought to the Libyan people 's quality of life .	anti-imperialist	Anti-imperialism

Conversely , domestically his social and economic reforms were strongly opposed by Islamic fundamentalists and he was internationally condemned as a dictator whose authoritarian administration violated the human rights of Libyan citizens and financed global terrorism .	Islamic fundamentalists	Islamic fundamentalism	dictator	dictatorship	human rights of Libyan citizens	Human rights in Libya	terrorism	terrorism
